- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#8 ("Ladder diagnostics for OLB G/S and the OLB training-side k* result (for C4/C6/C7)") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo, C5 (adaptivity) evidence, experiment-repo main 66252a8 / 249d537 (paper-repo dev 249d537):
  > - **Synthetic ladder, common target set** (`results/synth/synth_adaptive_common.csv`, L0-L5, 8 seeds): the batch design S6 beats the adaptive neighbour-tree interview S7 on every rung at k >= 2, by 0.04-0.07 (k = 2), 0.14-0.17 (k = 5, 8) and 0.03-0.06 (k = 20) MSE in standardised units; S7 recovers only 11-22% of S6's gain over random for k >= 2. So no rung shows an adaptive gain; this is for this adaptive rule only (T3: with known parameters an adaptive Bayesian design equals the batch one).
  > - **Real matrix** (MTEB G, 20 of 50 splits, `results/ct_extras/`): S7 beats random only for k <= 5 and is worse than random from k = 8 (-0.54 [-0.71, -0.39] points at k = 20); S6 is 0.6-1.0 points better than S7 at every k.
  > - Condition for the outline's "main text only if there is a gain": there is none, so C5 can be an appendix item with the negative result stated.
  > - Fixed-rank sensitivity, additionally (`results/sens_rank/paired_vs_innercv.csv`): at k = 20 a fixed rank 12 is 0.50 points [0.32, 0.69] better than the inner-CV rank (post hoc), so the k* of 32 is relative to a rank-16 floor and the cross-validated rank is not the best rank for the error at k = 20-50.
  > - Pre-registered criterion (iii) of Addendum 2 on OLB: passes on G, **fails on S at delta_floor** (-4 grid steps) and passes at 2 delta_floor; please record that as the branch for C7.
